treatment.logline: At a rain-soaked village sluice, Aruni recognizes her brother, finds a marked key still in his grasp, and is left alone with an unanswered attempt to reach Dinu.

arc.feeling: Personal loss held in check; a precise mystery

treatment.approach: Play the crime-thriller facet through withheld information and sustained observation, not action spectacle. Ground Aruni in small physical choices. Scoped village direction governs: locked frames, warm amber and earthy red within naturally dim rainy dawn, with no music. Give the recognition, hand and unanswered phone real screen time rather than adding incidents.

editor_notes: The 11 must clips total 60 seconds of raw takes, including handles; their intended order is approach, reveal, reaction, kneeling, key, L4, phone initiation, waiting, horn tableau, black, then title plate.
Nimal is placed beside the canal gate from the outset but outside the opening path frame; the packet does not place him before the discovery. Keep him entirely still in every view.

Aruni retains the medical-bag handle in her left hand throughout. Her right-hand contact is hidden behind Nimal's fist; she withdraws it between the kneeling and L4 views, draws the handset between L4 and the phone detail, and later holds it at her right ear. The key stays in Nimal's right fist.

The recognition reaction continues the master rather than replaying the stop. Match Aruni's eyeline and posture across the cut. Match the kneeling tableau and final horn tableau on the same bank axis; no visible hand-to-hand contact is required.

Composite the Dinu handset label and outgoing state over a clean source; conceal the single slow activation at the bezel. Do not imply a connected call, a response, a voicemail, or a hang-up. Add the faint outbound tone only after the device and initiation are visible.
Build the rain, wet footsteps, breath and distant bus horn in post, especially on clips marked silent to prevent invented speech. The horn stays off screen and beneath the rain; no music.

Hard-cut to an exact black generator, then overlay the supplied title EKAMA SAKSHIYA as post typography on black. The black plates are graphic sources, not a generated fade or a paired camera transition.

If wanted, speed ramp, freeze frame, digital punch-in and split screen are post-only treatments from clean sources; none is required for this restrained cut. Avoid slow motion, fast finger work, visible body contact and generated fine lettering.

editor_notes: The 11 must clips total 60 seconds of raw takes, including handles; their intended order is approach, reveal, reaction, kneeling, key, L4, phone initiation, waiting, horn tableau, black, then title plate.
Nimal is placed beside the canal gate from the outset but outside the opening path frame; the packet does not place him before the discovery. Keep him entirely still in every view.

Aruni retains the medical-bag handle in her left hand throughout. Her right-hand contact is hidden behind Nimal's fist; she withdraws it between the kneeling and L4 views, draws the handset between L4 and the phone detail, and later holds it at her right ear. The key stays in Nimal's right fist.

The recognition reaction continues the master rather than replaying the stop. Match Aruni's eyeline and posture across the cut. Match the kneeling tableau and final horn tableau on the same bank axis; no visible hand-to-hand contact is required.

Composite the Dinu handset label and outgoing state over a clean source; conceal the single slow activation at the bezel. Do not imply a connected call, a response, a voicemail, or a hang-up. Add the faint outbound tone only after the device and initiation are visible.
Build the rain, wet footsteps, breath and distant bus horn in post, especially on clips marked silent to prevent invented speech. The horn stays off screen and beneath the rain; no music.

Hard-cut to an exact black generator, then overlay the supplied title EKAMA SAKSHIYA as post typography on black. The black plates are graphic sources, not a generated fade or a paired camera transition.

If wanted, speed ramp, freeze frame, digital punch-in and split screen are post-only treatments from clean sources; none is required for this restrained cut. Avoid slow motion, fast finger work, visible body contact and generated fine lettering.

c15: Open moment 1 before c01; establish rain and canal ambience, then carry the rain across the cut to the walking master.

review.why: A single locked rain-and-earth texture grounds the exposed approach before the walking master.
The locked reveal and held recognition close-up already cover the turn; another reaction would repeat or interrupt it.
The bag-handle insert adds a restrained physical response without showing the concealed contact.
The locked insert already makes the key and its mark readable while preserving the closed fist.
The close single holds L4 and its aftermath; an extra image would weaken the direct appeal.
A tight eye-and-grip reaction concentrates the unanswered wait after the existing phone detail establishes the device.
A distant locked landscape view gives the isolated figures scale while the horn remains off screen.
The hard cut to the existing clean black source needs no generated transition.
The existing clean black plate leaves the supplied title to post without additional footage.
